versions.changelog:
baidu-ai-search-qianfan 1.0.0

- Initial release of the baidu-ai-search skill, integrating Baidu Qianfan AI search generation.
- Supports real-time web search with AI-generated answers and reference citations.
- Allows specifying model, search depth, filtering by time or resource type, and streaming output.
- Returns both summarized answers and detailed citation metadata for transparency.
- Uses the Baidu Qianfan API with up to 1,000 free daily requests by default.
